title: Instrument response file (instrument_<instrument>_<key>.json)
description:
One administration of one study instrument, saved alongside the block files in the session directory. The evaluation plan's after-every-session integrity check verifies that 'questionnaire files saved' — which is only checkable if the responses are machine-readable and schema-constrained, so they are files like every other output rather than paper that is transcribed later. DRAFT content: the item sets below mirror the constructs the evaluation plan already names (Phase 3) and are for review before ethics submission, not a validated scale (the exception is NASA-TLX, which is a published instrument used in its raw/unweighted form).

Naming: `instrument_<instrument>_<key>.json`, where key is the block_id for block-scoped instruments (nasa_tlx, administered immediately after each training block) and `<participant_id>_s<session>` for session-scoped ones.

instrument.description: pre_study: session 1 intake (driving history, sim hours, league check against the inclusion criteria). nasa_tlx: immediately after each session-2 training block. post_study: the session-3 confidence and perceived-dependence questionnaire. interview: the session-3 semi-structured interview's metadata and file references (the content lives in the audio and notes files, not here).

block_id.description: Required for nasa_tlx: the training block the ratings refer to. A TLX score with no block attached cannot be compared between conditions, which is the one thing the eval plan asks of it.

dry_run.description: Present and true only on a protocol dry run (M6, researcher as fake participant). Follows the dev_block/aborted pattern: its presence excludes the file from participant data.

variant.description: Raw (unweighted) NASA-TLX, i.e. RTLX: the six subscales are reported and averaged without the pairwise weighting procedure. Recorded explicitly so the thesis states which variant was used rather than leaving it to be inferred.

sim_racing_hours_total.description: Inclusion criterion (framing v6 line 177): under 20 hours across any title.

league_participation.description: Inclusion criterion: must be false. Recorded rather than screened silently so an exclusion can be explained in the dataset README.

eligibility_confirmed.description: The experimenter's recorded decision at intake. Kept separate from the raw criteria so a disagreement between the two is visible at analysis instead of silently resolved.

noticed_fading.description: RQ3's alignment analysis turns on this: whether the participant noticed elements disappearing at all.

tlxScale.description: NASA-TLX subscale, 0-100 in steps of 5 (the standard 21-point scale read onto 0-100).

likert7.description: 7-point Likert item, 1 = strongly disagree, 7 = strongly agree.
